| # Object 0x1001 error register {#object-0x1001-error-register-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                   |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The error register is a field of 8 bits, each for a certain error type. If an error occurs the bit has to be set.

  Index           0x1001
  --------------- ----------------
  Name            Error register
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 8
  Category        Mandatory
  Access          RO
  PDO Mapping     Optional
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 8
  Default Value   0

 

 

## Structure of Error Register {#structure-of-error-register .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ----- ----- -------------------------------------------
  Bit   M/O   Meaning
  0     M     Generic error
  1     O     Current
  2     O     Voltage
  3     O     Temperature
  4     O     Communication error(overrun, error state)
  5     O     Device profile specific
  6     O     Reserved (always 0)
  7     O     Manufacture specific
  ----- ----- -------------------------------------------

 

M: Mandatory; O: Optional

If a bit is set to 1 the specified error has occurred. The only mandatory error that has to be signalled is

the generic error. The generic error is signaled at any error situation.
